Setting remove_navigation to false preserves nav and aside elements

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<nav>SiteMenu</nav><main><p>MainContent</p></main><aside>SidebarText</aside>", "{\"preprocessing\":{\"remove_navigation\":false}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
